note: The front-of-house layer. Nine jobs an operator actually thinks about. Every one maps to task ids in tasks.json — the mapping is the guarantee that the simple view is not a summary written from memory. Validated by scripts/check_workstreams.py: 80/80 covered, no duplicates.

statuses.waiting: Built, waiting on one thing you own
statuses.partial: Half live — some pieces proven, some not

order.title: Perfect the front nine
order.detail: Get each job below doing its one thing reliably on real deals. Nothing else starts until these are boring.

order.title: Perfect the back end
order.detail: Then tighten the micro-processes underneath: retries, ledgers, duplicate prevention, audit, cost guards.

order.title: Make it recursive
order.detail: Then let outcomes feed back into scoring weights, letters, and vertical playbooks so cycle 30 is better than cycle 1.

workstreams.name: Runs without you
workstreams.one_line: The engine room: it wakes up daily, refuses to spend money, refuses to send twice, and keeps a log of everything it did.
workstreams.you_get: Today: a daily cycle that runs and reports. Missing: the locks and audit trail that make it safe to leave alone for a month.
workstreams.next: Single-flight lock, audit log, dead-letter retry, kill switch. Everything else depends on these being real, so this is first.

workstreams.name: Find deals
workstreams.one_line: Scans marketplaces and broker firms every morning and turns listings into a clean, complete deal file.
workstreams.you_get: 43 listings scanned → 11 ready-to-work deals, 32 flagged with the exact field that's missing.
workstreams.next: Add two more sources (BizQuest, Flippa) so a slow week on one marketplace doesn't stall the pipeline.

workstreams.name: Investigate & score
workstreams.one_line: Puts every deal through the QLA test — red flags, the specifics, the local market — then tells you go or no-go.
workstreams.you_get: A 10-factor score with GO/NO-GO, and a refusal to score when the numbers aren't real.
workstreams.blocker: The deep-dive pieces (red flags, lice-comb, market pack) are specified but not built yet
workstreams.next: Build the red-flag sweep and the target profile card, so a score sits on top of evidence instead of a listing headline.

workstreams.name: Build your court
workstreams.one_line: Finds and writes to the chairman, board, CPA, counsel and banker — plus the moles who tell you the truth about a market.
workstreams.you_get: 31 verified people across four roles, every email address live-checked.
workstreams.blocker: Your email address + app password (GMAIL_ADDRESS, GMAIL_APP_PASSWORD)
workstreams.next: Once mail is on, send the first wave and track who replies. Mole questions come after the court is warm.

workstreams.name: Run outreach
workstreams.one_line: Sends the letters by email where published, and fills the contact form where that's all a firm offers.
workstreams.you_get: Two channels from one queue: form filling already proven (9 of 10 fields on a live firm form).
workstreams.blocker: Email needs the same password as W3; forms work without it
workstreams.next: Approve the first form submission, then the rest can run unattended.

workstreams.name: Read replies
workstreams.one_line: Reads the inbox, sorts interested from not-interested, matches each reply to the right deal, and moves that deal forward.
workstreams.you_get: Deal status updates you didn't have to touch; anything unclear comes to you labelled REVIEW instead of guessed.
workstreams.blocker: Mailbox access (same credentials) — the logic is built and passed its tests
workstreams.next: Run one live week of replies before trusting the classification.

workstreams.name: Do the paperwork
workstreams.one_line: Drafts the LOI, tests the 1.5x coverage rule, structures the seller note, assembles the contract pack, then runs the closing checklist.
workstreams.you_get: A 2,200-word LOI and a coverage test with the arithmetic shown — and a hard refusal if a money figure was guessed.
workstreams.blocker: Closing plan and transition plan are specified, not built
workstreams.next: Attach the diligence checklist so an LOI can't go out before documents are in.

workstreams.name: Book your time
workstreams.one_line: Collects everything that genuinely needs a human into one queue, with a brief and a proposed time.
workstreams.you_get: A short list of calendar items — who to call, why now, the three questions, how long it takes.
workstreams.next: Decide calendar: keep sending .ics files to Drive, or re-authorise the token for real calendar writes.

workstreams.name: Learn from every deal
workstreams.one_line: Records why each deal lived or died and feeds that back into the scoring and the letters.
workstreams.you_get: Nothing yet — this is the loop that makes the system improve instead of repeat.
workstreams.blocker: Needs outcome data, which needs W1–W6 running for a few weeks
workstreams.next: Log outcomes from day one so the data exists when this gets built.
